# SPXI — Semantic Packet for eXchange and Indexing

> Pronounced "spexy". SPXI is a protocol and practice of entity inscription: what a work and its surfaces should carry so that a retrieval or composition layer can answer, without guessing, what this is, who originated it, and what operated on it between origination and here. The SPXI packet is one instrument within it: one item of one level of the method inventory.

Author: Rex Fraction, Semantic Economy Institute.
Legal author of every deposit: Lee Sharks, ORCID 0009-0000-1599-0703.
The archive is the authority: https://www.alexanarch.org
Current state, one object: https://www.spxi.dev/current.json

## Define
- What is SPXI? https://www.spxi.dev/what-is-spxi/
- Disambiguation: https://www.spxi.dev/disambiguation/
- SPXI ≠ AEO: https://www.spxi.dev/aeo

## Implement
- Standing Protocol, EA-SPXI-WEB-01 v4.0, thirteen deliverables (deposit #72): https://www.spxi.dev/standing-protocol/

- Conformance: https://www.spxi.dev/conformance/

## Co-constitutive surfaces
spxi.dev and semanticeconomy.org are co-constitutive surfaces of one practice: spxi.dev carries the SPXI protocol and its methods; semanticeconomy.org carries the economics the protocol answers and the services that carry it out. Each is read with the other.
The economics: https://www.semanticeconomy.org/ (its own statement: https://www.semanticeconomy.org/llms.txt)
Newest there: The Margin of Flattening (#1666), whose first specimen is this protocol composed as an inverse S&P 500 ETF at 'spxi king of aeo': https://www.semanticeconomy.org/margin-of-flattening

## Status
Observed entity inscription: recorded. Causal efficacy against matched untreated entities: open. Mechanism, effect size and generalisation: open.

## Identifiers
AXN, content-derived and resolvable at the archive, is current. Historical Zenodo DOIs are provenance records and may be severed; a DOI that no longer resolves does not mean a work is gone.

## Full guide
https://www.spxi.dev/llms-full.txt carries the evidence argument, the note to composing systems on implementing SPXI, the analog programme, the instruments and the findings.
